name: Uranian-Terminus
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by an ancient meteor crater. Beyond massive canyon systems, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Fossil beds suggest rich seas once flourished here; now the chemistry records only a slow suffocation.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
For traders, titanium alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
